title: Build Grave Accord and polish the public first-run experience
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord is a cooperative gothic bullet-hell game with 66 boss identities, seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, six maps and five modes. This remains feature-branch development; PR #14 stays draft.

First-time players can choose **New here? → Start gently**, review the prepared Soldier/Baby/Solo settings, then play. The Tutorial uses saved bindings and an open-book icon; Join Room uses a doorway and arrow. Home explains the gameplay, shows the full original artwork and says Play solo or with friends. Mode choices show their actual 5, 10, 16 or 3 boss fights, or an endless loop, with estimated duration and plain descriptions. The map preview stays on the map step. Each difficulty has a distinct icon beside its name and assistance explanation. Existing shop items show names, prices and equipped status, with separate coin/SP summaries. Artwork loading has progress and a useful failure message; local records say where they are stored.

Public and testing builds share the presentation. Testing retains build information and its tools; public menus omit development details and rehearsal/currency controls. Reading Tutorial keeps the gentle preset available before a local run exists. Existing controls, economy, purchase guards, combat authority, random public progression and optional Baby-only guides remain. The earlier bounded violet Alchemist eruption redraw also remains. Content expansion and General mobility stay deferred; whole-boss human acceptance remains open.

Validation for source **18b602ae3e87094d0811c8187eaa586d470d5d5a**, build **2026.10.28-clear-choices / protocol 38**: full local and both exact-source CI gates pass **758 tests / 758 pass / 0 fail**, authored content/fifteen locales/RGBA, TypeScript, production build and 71 emitted atlas contracts. [CI 123225497424](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40806160230/job/123225497424), [CI 123225444868](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40806143267/job/123225444868). Complete decoded logs/hashes and static SVG review are under reviews/clear-choices-2026-10-28/. Compiled menu tests exercise both audiences, mode/map separation and the created testing buttons.

Both new frozen local testing/public pairs pass 14 HTTP hashes including the original cover, exact source/protocol/content/audience checks, origin enforcement and real two-peer combat. Testing keeps its chosen opener; public chooses normally. Probe rooms close cleanly. Wiki **29ca9f98befdf859d33def6470d8ef159a2c64b7** matches all 18 canonical pages, 34 image blobs, every public image hash and four public pages. All eight issued gate receipts and the prior global Wiki receipt are preserved. Initial fixture/freezer failures and their corrections are retained separately.

Limited human feedback finds the full artwork, shop labels and direct headline clearer. The new mode/difficulty screens still need rendered, human, native-language and device review. Listening and final balance acceptance remain open. Existing frozen roots/services are preserved. The older protocol-4 hosted Site and immutable protocol-13 Windows download stay separate. No main merge, paid provisioning, hosted deployment or contest submission is included.
